title: Rule of three: a string buffer
hints: Store `size_` and `data_` (a `char*` of `size_ + 1` chars, the last one `'\0'`).
Copy constructor: allocate a new array and copy the characters (a deep copy, as in Tableau v3).
Assignment: copy-and-swap (Tableau v4). `append`: allocate a bigger array, copy both parts, then release the old one.
